spec_deviations: ByteBlock replaces raw ByteArray in domain models (immutability + value equality)
domain transport exception types added so TAG_LOST is distinguishable from NAK_REFUSED
WriteVerdict.UNKNOWN_LOCK_STATE added for an unreadable page 0x02
WriteDecision.Allowed carries acknowledgedRisk so expert mode does not hide danger
TagIdentity.cascadeLevels widened to Int?
ManufacturerDecoder.kt folded into Manufacturer companion
MemoryRenderer returns null rather than a status label (i18n + no-fake-zeros)
domain purity guard extended to androidx.* and made self-testing
material-icons-extended dropped (deprecated, version-skewed)
TagReport/TagPresentation added to carry identity+dump+locks as one value, with no failed variant (partial answers are still answers)
lock page (0x02) reports UNKNOWN_LOCK_STATE when lock bytes are unreadable, so lock bits cannot be set blind
MemoryDump enforces page ordering and page width via init requires
Manufacturer.knownCodes exposed so the vendor table itself is testable
ChipProfile.geometryConfirmed added; resolver returns a 16-page family floor rather than claiming MF0ICU1, since TYPE_ULTRALIGHT is shared with EV1 and all NTAG21x
TagIoException added: Android cannot distinguish a NAK from a general transport fault
WriteOutcome.Written carries readBack so success is demonstrated; verified is null (not false) when read-back could not run
MainActivity is a temporary Phase 2 device-proof harness, replaced by Task 3.2
Tasks 3.3-3.6 folded into 3.2 rather than run as a parallel wave: screens are small and share the nav contract
ChipProfile.geometryConfirmed surfaced in the UI with an explanation string rather than a bare badge
Log filtering is by minimum level, not exact level
